title: Add mock-HTTP tests for updatable-cli check_latest/stage_next happy path
description: The core download/verify/stage flow (Updater::check_latest, stage_next, verify_sha256 against a real release shape) has no test coverage; only release_target, sha256 verify, and current_status are tested in src/lib.rs. A mockito/httpmock-backed test serving a fake releases/latest JSON plus a tarball+sha256 asset would harden the riskiest network path. Filed via reflect-session/cacophony-bead-scope from updatable-cli scaffold review (no active bead; queue empty).

bead.title: Add integration test for updatable-cli promote_next / maybe_apply_staged_update
bead.description: promote_next and maybe_apply_staged_update perform the on-disk rename/re-exec promotion contract (the riskiest part touching real binaries), but src/lib.rs only tests current_status. A tempdir-based test that stages a fake <tool>_next, calls promote_next, and asserts the installed binary appears with 0755 perms (and that promote_next returns None when nothing is staged) would lock in the promotion semantics. Filed via reflect-session/cacophony-bead-scope from updatable-cli scaffold review (no active bead; queue empty).
